providers.heading: Providers
providers.caption: Install-wide · every brand uses these credentials · Install admins only
providers.footer: Credentials are encrypted with APP_MASTER_KEY and never sent back to the browser. Keys set in .env override what is saved here and are locked.

provider.addCaption: Credentials are encrypted when you save
provider.locked: HD_AI_PROVIDERS in .env sets every provider, so none can be changed here.
provider.baseUrlHint: Only for OpenAI-compatible servers or a gateway. Fetched through the outbound safety client.
provider.idHint: A lower-case name brands refer to it by, such as openai. It cannot be changed later.
provider.label: Name

apiKey.title: API key
apiKey.body: The supported path. Billed to your provider account.

oauth.title: OAuth or subscription sign-in
oauth.body: At your own risk: check the provider's terms before using a personal subscription.
oauth.unavailable: This provider offers no subscription sign-in.

none.title: No key
none.body: A local server that asks for none, such as Ollama.

provider.apiKeyHint: Encrypted on save; the value is never shown again.
provider.oauthHint: Run npx @mariozechner/pi-ai login {{kind}} on your own machine and paste the auth.json it writes.
provider.oauthStored: Sign-in credentials are stored. Helpdock refreshes them when they expire.
provider.discoverSaveFirst: Save the provider to discover its models.
provider.modelsShowing: Showing {{shown}} of {{total}} · prices from pi-ai's model registry, used for cost in ai_calls
provider.removeBody: Its credentials are deleted and no brand can use it any more.

problems.idInvalid: Use 1 to 40 lower-case letters, digits and hyphens.
problems.baseUrlInvalid: Enter an address starting with http:// or https://.
problems.oauthInvalid: Paste the JSON with access, refresh and expires.

chatModel.heading: Chat model
chatModel.caption: Used by agent assist, auto-reply and triage
chatModel.installDefaultHint: Only models discovered from a provider are listed.
chatModel.lockedHint: Set by HD_AI_DEFAULT_PROVIDER and HD_AI_DEFAULT_MODEL in .env.
chatModel.perBrandCaption: A brand's Admin may pick another model. Tokens and cost are tracked per brand either way.

transcription.heading: Voice transcription
transcription.caption: Voice notes from the widget and Telegram get a transcript agents can read
transcription.endpointHint: For example https://api.openai.com/v1/audio/transcriptions. Empty turns transcription off.
transcription.endpointInvalid: Enter an address starting with http:// or https://, or leave it empty.
transcription.off: Off · voice notes are not transcribed

embeddings.heading: Embeddings
embeddings.caption: One model for the whole install · used to search knowledge for every brand
embeddings.reindexing: Reindexing to {{model}} ({{dims}} dims). Until it finishes, auto-reply and suggestions use full-text search only. Helpdock never serves results from two embedding models at once.
embeddings.failed: The re-embed stopped: {{error}}. It is retried every minute, and nothing mixed is served meanwhile.
embeddings.endpointHint: OpenAI-compatible: OpenAI, Voyage or a local Ollama.
embeddings.readyLine: {{model}} · {{dims}} dims · {{chunks}} chunks. Every chunk carries the model's name; search only ranks chunks of the current model.
embeddings.frozen: These settings can be changed again when reindexing finishes.

problems.providerRequired: Name the provider, for the cost log.
problems.baseUrlInvalid: Enter an address starting with http:// or https://.
problems.dimsInvalid: Enter a whole number from 1 to 2000.
problems.dimsTooMany: {{dims}} is above the 2000 the vector index supports. Pick a smaller model, or one that can shorten its output (for example 1536).

dialog.title: Change the embedding model?
dialog.body: Every knowledge source of every brand is embedded again: {{chunks}} chunks, at the new model's price.
dialog.fallback: While it runs, auto-reply and suggestions fall back to full-text search, and admins see a reindexing banner.
dialog.dropped: The old index is dropped first. Vectors from the two models are never ranked together.
dialog.failure: If it fails, the status stays “Reindexing” until it is retried. Nothing mixed is served.

assistant.noProvider: No AI provider is set up. Modes stay off until an install admin adds one in
assistant.reindexing: Knowledge is being reindexed. Until it finishes, auto-reply and suggestions use full-text search only.

budgetBanner.exceededTitle: Budget reached — auto-reply is off until {{date}}.
budgetBanner.exceededAssistOn: The {{period}} limit of {{limit}} was reached. Visitors are answered by people; agent assist stays on. Raise the limit to turn auto-reply back on now.
budgetBanner.exceededAssistOff: The {{period}} limit of {{limit}} was reached. Visitors are answered by people, and agent assist is off too. Raise the limit to turn AI back on now.

modes.heading: Modes
modes.caption: Each mode is on or off for this brand
modes.agentAssistBody: Helps agents in the ticket. Nothing is sent to a customer without an agent pressing Send. May use internal sources; their citations are marked internal.
modes.autoReplyBody: Answers visitors from public knowledge with citations and an AI badge. Below the confidence threshold it hands off to a person instead of answering.
modes.offCaption: Off · replies come from people only
modes.firstResponseBody: The same setting as in Ticketing › SLAs. A handoff message never counts.
modes.handoffBody: Sent when the assistant hands off or a visitor asks for a person (“talk to a human” always works). After a handoff the assistant stays quiet for the rest of the conversation unless an agent returns it.
modes.triageNote: Auto-triage is not a mode here: it runs as an AI triage action in

guardrails.heading: Guardrails
guardrails.caption: On for every brand; only the injection filter can be turned off

pii.title: PII redaction
pii.body: Emails, phone numbers, card numbers (Luhn-checked) and IBANs are replaced with placeholders before any text reaches the model, and restored for agents in the reply. The model never sees the originals.

injection.title: Injection filter on ingested content
injection.body: Crawled and imported text is scanned for instructions aimed at the assistant; they are stripped and the chunk is marked suspicious.

noTools.title: No tools or actions
noTools.body: The assistant can only read knowledge and write text. It cannot change tickets, call services or send anything an agent or a rule did not allow.

logged.title: Every output is logged
logged.body: Model, prompt hash, sources, tokens and cost are stored for each call and shown on the ticket. Bodies are kept for the brand's AI log retention.

budget.heading: Budget
budget.caption: USD, from the cost of each call
budget.invalid: Enter an amount above 0, or leave it empty.
budget.alertNote: At 80 % of either limit an alert is written to the brand's audit log.
budget.hardStopBody: Auto-reply turns off on every channel until the period resets or the limit is raised.
budget.keepAssist: Keep agent assist on after the hard stop

prompt.heading: System prompt
prompt.caption: Tone, language policy and forbidden topics · Admins and Team Leaders can edit
prompt.arHint: Empty: the English prompt is used for Arabic conversations too.
prompt.hint: Helpdock adds its own rules after yours (cite sources, hand off when unsure, no tools). They cannot be removed here. PII is redacted before the prompt is sent.

activity.heading: AI activity
activity.caption: Recent calls for this brand · tokens in / out
activity.footer: Each row is one ai_calls entry. Open the ticket to see the sources it used.
